status: NEVER FLASHED TO HARDWARE — built and host-tested only. Flash in place per the runbook (spec section 6); take an avrdude flash dump first.
flash_via: DroidNet web UI -> Flash tab: select Board Type Arduino Mega, upload the .hex, flash. Unplug the WCB serial lead from the Mega (D0/RX0 and D1/TX0, or the whole connector) while flashing: UART0 is shared with the USB-serial chip.
board: FlthyHPs Holoprojectors (Ryan Sondgeroth) — Arduino Mega ADK, ATmega2560

native_commands.summary: unit F R T X Y Z A (stock designator fan-out), level 1-255; RAM only, anything else ignored

wdp_announce.summary: one @WDP1 line to the WCB on UART0 (D0/D1, 9600 baud; also the USB serial) 0.5-3 s after boot, then every 25-30 s

droidnet_flash.select_chip: Arduino Mega (select it by hand; do not rely on auto-detect)
droidnet_flash.note: On a ttyACM Mega the Booster does not detect the ATmega2560 signature: auto-detect probes avr109 and stk500v1, then guesses with avrdude -n in the order uno, nano, mega, and it probes the first /dev/ttyACM* port, which may be another device. Select Board Type Arduino Mega. Unplug the WCB serial lead from the Mega (D0/RX0 and D1/TX0, or the whole connector) while flashing: UART0 is shared with the USB-serial chip. Flashing uses avrdude with the STK500v2 'wiring' programmer @ 115200.

dependencies.note: Resolved by `pio pkg list` and linked per the `pio run` Dependency Graph for this image. The requirements float, so a later rebuild may resolve newer versions.
